newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance stake cut by James Terra.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance stake cut by James Terra.

text.p: James Terra, executor of the estate of Daniel Terra, former chairman of Mercury Finance Co, said Tuesday he cut his stake in the automobile finance company to 6,884,196 common shares or 3.9 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Terra said his latest transactions include the sale of 3,680,500 shares between May 6 and May 19 at prices ranging from $1.503 to $2.2708 per share.
Terra, son of Daniel Terra, said he sold the shares to raise cash to pay the estate's general obligations.
